title: Auto-block review loops before the next revision cycle, not after
_pr_pinning: the PR number pinned by --pr lives in the gitignored sidecar tasks/<id>/.pr-number (not in this file); --ship reads it for forge-proof merge verification. Sidecar absence is valid (legacy/pre-PR state).

escalations.reason: Spec review hit 3 changes_requested iterations in a row (limit: 3). Pipeline auto-blocked before another spec revision. Read the latest spec-review.md: if review is still converging (each round narrows on distinct, legitimate findings), raise the cap and continue — MAX_REVIEW_LOOPS=<n> canon run preroute-review-loop-autoblock --step — rather than resetting the counter, which throws away that signal. Only reset the counter if you're revising scope enough that prior iterations no longer apply: set phases.spec_review.status = "pending" and phases.spec_review.iterations_current_loop = 0 in status.json, then re-run the pipeline.

Spec review hit 4 changes_requested iterations in a row (limit: 4). Pipeline auto-blocked before another spec revision. Read the latest spec-review.md: if review is still converging (each round narrows on distinct, legitimate findings), raise the cap and continue — MAX_REVIEW_LOOPS=<n> canon run preroute-review-loop-autoblock --step — rather than resetting the counter, which throws away that signal. Only reset the counter if you're revising scope enough that prior iterations no longer apply: set phases.spec_review.status = "pending" and phases.spec_review.iterations_current_loop = 0 in status.json, then re-run the pipeline.

_verdict_values: approved | approved_with_nits | changes_requested | needs_re_review (legacy alias, routed/counted as changes_requested) | spec_gap | sanctioned (operator-only via canon task accept)
_full_send: true → skip spec gate + auto-open draft PR after clean QA. See docs/pipeline-orchestrator.md (`--full-send`).
